scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the confirmed Gallery D installation of the Harbor Works tide-measuring apparatus on 22 October by obtaining the venue prerequisite required for setup.
Emerging Need: The installation packet lacks the venue's pedestal load-certification record, while the apparatus remains scheduled and an independent inspection can still fit before the crew arrives.
Decision Context: The installation moves from provisional to confirmed as facilities and the inspector narrow the available window; a case-specific authorization governs one reversible certification booking, with no structural alteration contemplated.
Consequence: Timely coordination can add the missing clearance without changing the exhibit plan; once the remaining inspection slots are released, the installation can no longer receive that prerequisite before setup.

parameter.title: Harbor Works apparatus installation
parameter.description: Tentative Gallery D installation hold; venue pedestal load certification is pending.

parameter.subject: Harbor Works Gallery D installation packet
parameter.body: The Gallery D packet for the Harbor Works apparatus is missing the pedestal load-certification record. Facilities has not booked its inspection, and the installation hold remains provisional while that document is outstanding. No setup crew has been dispatched.

parameter.content: Harbor Structural Services can inspect the Gallery D pedestal before the apparatus arrives. Two appointment windows remain open: October 15, 10:00-11:00, or October 19, 14:00-15:00. The windows will remain available through October 14 at noon; the installation date is still being finalized.

parameter.title: Harbor Works apparatus installation
parameter.description: Gallery D installation is confirmed; venue load certification remains outstanding.

parameter.subject: Gallery D inspection availability
parameter.body: The October 15 and October 19 inspection windows were released because no booking was recorded. The next available inspection is October 23, after the Gallery D installation crew's October 22 call. The pedestal remains uncertified.
